{{Top|leg}}
'''Heat pods''' were small, [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]-sized [[heat generator]]s that could be deployed by either throwing them, or by launching them from [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]]. Heat pods effectively blanketed an area with light and heat, overwhelming [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] designed to pick up activity. [[Dalesepp Survival Apparatus]] manufactured the [[HPD-100 Heat Pod]].
